d.title: Ichigo Aika: Zatsu de Namaiki na Imouto to Warikirenai Ani
d.jp: イチゴ哀歌～雑で生イキな妹と割り切れない兄～
d.synopsis: The series follows Kouta, who gets a new younger sister named Aika after his father remarries. Aika is a gyaru with a dual personality: she acts kindly to her parents, but shows a brattier side to others, including Kouta. Aika quickly develops a fondness for her new stepbrother, and the two form a sexual relationship.
